title: PowerShell spawned from Notepad
message: notepad.exe started powershell.exe with suspicious encoded args.
recommendation: Immediately suspend/kill powershell.exe and investigate parent notepad.exe. Restrict PowerShell execution policy.

title: DLL Injection into explorer.exe
message: explorer.exe loaded non-signed DLL from %TEMP% directory.
recommendation: Quarantine system, capture memory, and remove persistence. Validate explorer.exe modules and check startup entries.

title: Outbound connection anomaly
message: Process connected to atypical IP over TLS.
recommendation: Block egress to the IP, check DNS logs, and review proxy history.
